title: TrueRise audit event, v2 (tightened)
description: One record of the append-only audit hash chain. Clean-room contract derived from the behaviour spec: the record carries {seq, ts, kind, severity, detail, prev_hash, hash}; hash = SHA256 over the canonical serialization of all fields except hash; extra fields are forbidden (tightened edition). The legacy v1 edition stays valid for reading but is excluded from governance decisions (handled at the wire type level in M1).

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number, contiguous within one chain.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous record (genesis: 64 zeros).

hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of all fields except hash.
